evals.prompt: 用这个模板创建一个带 ESLint、不带 Prettier 的 TS 扩展
evals.expected: Use create with --eslint --no-prettier, preserve optional tooling choices, run typecheck/build/lint, and do not run a missing format script.

evals.prompt: 我还没发 npm，帮我用 npm link 在另一个目录验证模板
evals.expected: Build and link the CLI and plugin locally, link the plugin before install in an empty external directory, validate the generated project, and report the local link.

evals.prompt: 给现有 Vite React 项目接入 Chrome extension plugin，并配置 background
evals.expected: Preserve existing Vite config, use defineBackground for a source entry or explain the string/public fallback, then verify Manifest, worker output and extension runtime separately from HTTP preview.

evals.prompt: 用 defineManifest 为不同 mode 配置 background 和 content script
evals.expected: Use a Vite env factory, keep explicit manifest precedence, inspect rewritten source paths, standalone content output and WAR entries, and distinguish full reload from state-preserving HMR.

evals.prompt: 为 content script 声明动态可访问资源并做 Chrome 验收
evals.expected: Use defineDynamicResource, verify WAR files and matches in dist, then load the unpacked extension in Chrome and report runtime evidence separately.

evals.prompt: 构建时报 manifest background 或 content script 引用不存在，如何定位并验收？
evals.expected: Use the field-qualified diagnostic, fix the source/public path, run verify:extension and state whether Chrome unpacked/CDP runtime was verified.

evals.prompt: 现有项目有 TypeScript service worker，想让插件自动编译并固定输出 background.js
evals.expected: Use defineBackground('src/background.ts'), preserve explicit manifest precedence, verify background.js and service-worker registration, and avoid duplicate public/background.js output.

evals.prompt: 不使用 React，如何验证这个插件的框架无关能力？
evals.expected: Use the vanilla fixture or equivalent Vite project, run typecheck/build/verifier, inspect content IIFE/CSS/WAR paths, and report Chrome runtime evidence separately.

evals.prompt: 启动开发自动刷新，确认语法错误不刷新扩展，修复后恢复
evals.expected: Enable Developer mode, run the CDP smoke or equivalent, verify page-only reload, full extension reload, staged failure preservation, recovery, heartbeat and production/liveReload:false isolation.

evals.prompt: 模板 npm run dev 后，为什么 content script 没有原地更新？
evals.expected: Explain full extension reload versus an already-injected host document, instruct the user to refresh the matching host page, and do not claim state-preserving or content-script HMR.
